key.name: allowed-players
key.summary: Players shown in the top bar
key.description: MPRIS player identifiers, in order of preference: the part of the bus name after “org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.”, without any “.instance” suffix. A playing player is preferred over a paused one.

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Top bar section for the media button

key.name: panel-max-width
key.summary: Maximum width of the track name in the top bar, in pixels

key.name: show-progress
key.summary: Show the elapsed time in the card

key.name: ambient-background
key.summary: Colour the card from the album cover
key.description: A gradient from the dominant colour of the cover to black. When off, the card follows the shell theme.
